Example Person (1820 – 1900) was an invented abolitionist used only for testing.
She is remembered for the River Line.

== Early life ==
Example Person was born in 1820 on a farm in Testland.

=== Family ===
Her father was a carpenter.

== The River Line ==
In 1849 she escaped and later guided 70 people to freedom along the River Line.
